_comment: Cross-rack reuse demo (WITHOUT JBOF) — identical to cross_rack_jbof.json but NO pod-wide JBOF tier, so tray-0 contexts cascade NPU->CPU->COLDSTORE. Tray 1 still reuses them cross-rack, but reloads from the slow COLDSTORE instead of JBOF -> higher TTFT. Run: --tier-policy exclusive --prefix-storage COLDSTORE --request-routing-policy CUSTOM --cpu-scope per_node --max-num-seqs 1 --enable-prefix-caching --enable-prefix-sharing
